details: Iran has introduced "Hormuz Safe," a platform allowing Bitcoin-settled insurance policies for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Reports indicate that IRGC-linked entities are already accepting Bitcoin or stablecoins for safe-passage permits, formalizing a method to collect payments outside traditional banking channels due to heavy financial sanctions.
title: Iran to Charge Bitcoin for Strait of Hormuz Transit Fees.

details: Former U.S. President Donald Trump engaged in a 90-minute phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin, reportedly offering to facilitate a peace agreement for the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. This marks a renewed diplomatic effort amid a stalemate in hostilities.
title: Trump Discusses Ukraine Peace Mediation in Call with Putin.

details: Geopolitical tensions are pushing investors towards safer assets and away from high-beta plays like cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin and other major altcoins are hovering near key support levels after a modest pullback, with options and futures data indicating increased demand for downside protection and a cautious trading environment.
title: Rising Geopolitical Tensions Drive Crypto Volatility, Investor De-Risking.

details: Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn) reported a significant surge in Q2 revenue, driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence products. However, the world's largest contract electronics maker issued a caution regarding the impact of ongoing global political and economic volatility on its outlook.
title: Foxconn Warns on Geopolitical Volatility After Strong AI-Driven Quarter.
